title: Collection
lead: The skills you have obtained or forged, and what became of them. Your deck holds 7 at most.
empty_filter: Nothing in this category. Win a ranked game to forge or take a skill.
note_unique: Unique skill: it exists in only one deck in the world and doesn't count toward the three skills selected for a game. Far more powerful than a basic skill.
note_classic: Classic skill: it counts toward the three skills selected before the game, chosen from your deck of 7 at most.
src_refill: Gifted: your deck had fewer than 3 skills
src_taken: Taken by your opponent after a loss
